name: BRL Carry-to-Vol Ratio
description: Historical analysis of BRL implied carry-to-volatility ratio. Carry proxy: 63-day annualized rolling return on USDBRL (sign-flipped so positive = BRL carry attractive). Vol: 60-day annualized realized volatility. Ratio = carry / vol. Outputs: ratio time series with moving average, expanding percentile rank, and distribution histogram.
source:
# BRL Carry-to-Vol Ratio — Historical Analysis
# Carry proxy: -1 × 63d annualized return (positive = BRL carry attractive)
# Vol: 60d annualized realized volatility
# Ratio: carry / vol — higher = more carry per unit of risk

# --- Data ---
src = fx_pairs(ticker='USDBRL')()
close = src.c
ts = index().value

# --- Carry Proxy ---
# 63-day simple return, sign-flipped and annualized
# USDBRL rising = BRL weakening, so flip sign: positive carry = BRL attractive
ret_63d = returns(period=63)(close)
carry = ret_63d * -1.0 * (252.0 / 63.0)

# --- Realized Volatility ---
# 60-day realized vol (annualized) — feed price levels per S47
real_vol = volatility(period=60)(close)

# --- Carry-to-Vol Ratio ---
# Guard against division by zero/near-zero vol
ratio = where(is_valid(real_vol) and real_vol > 0.01, carry / real_vol)

# --- Smoothing ---
ratio_ma = ma(period=63, type=MAType.sma)(ratio)

# --- Expanding Percentile Rank ---
# Manual expanding min-max normalization → 0-100 scale
exp_min = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(ratio)
exp_max = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(ratio)
exp_range = exp_max - exp_min
pct_rank = where(is_valid(exp_range) and exp_range > 0.001, (ratio - exp_min) / exp_range * 100.0)

# --- Event Markers: Extreme Readings ---
is_extreme_high = is_valid(pct_rank) and pct_rank > 90
is_extreme_low = is_valid(pct_rank) and pct_rank < 10
regime_label = conditional_select(is_extreme_high, "Rich Carry", is_extreme_low, "Cheap Carry", "Normal")
is_extreme = is_extreme_high or is_extreme_low

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Carry/Vol Extreme',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Regime', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry/Vol Ratio', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Percentile', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='USDBRL', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(regime_label, ratio, pct_rank, close, is_extreme)

# --- Chart 1: Carry/Vol Ratio Time Series ---
xy_lines(
    title='BRL Carry/Vol Ratio — Is the Carry Worth the Risk?',
    category='BRL Carry Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Carry / Vol',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Carry/Vol Ratio', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='63d MA', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(ratio, ratio_ma))

# --- Chart 2: Expanding Percentile Rank ---
xy_lines(
    title='Where Does Current Carry/Vol Rank in History?',
    category='BRL Carry Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Percentile (0-100)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Expanding Percentile', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=50.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Median'),
        ReferenceLine(value=90.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='90th'),
        ReferenceLine(value=10.0, color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='10th')
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(color=Color.Red, opacity=0.08, label='Rich Carry', to=100.0),
        PlotBand(color=Color.Green, opacity=0.08, label='Cheap Carry', to=10.0)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(pct_rank,))

# --- Chart 3: Distribution Histogram ---
histogram(
    title='How Often Does BRL Offer Attractive Carry/Vol?',
    category='BRL Carry Analysis',
    bins=40,
    x_axis_label='Carry/Vol Ratio',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    fill_opacity=0.7,
    show_analytics=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    order=3
)(ratio)
